description: This file defines a helper class for generating JWT tokens for test users with specific roles, used in functional testing of the web API.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates and returns a JWT token for an administrator user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates and returns a JWT token for a regular user.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token string with specified username and roles.
